publication.title: Rhabdodontid (Dinosauria, Ornithopoda) diversity suggested by the first documented occurrence of associated cranial and postcranial material at Vălioara (uppermost Cretaceous Densuș-Ciula Formation, Hațeg Basin, Romania)
authors: A. Ősi, F. J. Augustin, G. Botfalvai

locality.name: PBDB collection 163322: Pareu Niagului (Creek), Site II, near Valioara, "Valioara, Neagului Cr."

age.basis: PBDB assigns collection 163322 to Early Maastrichtian with numeric bounds 72.2–66 Ma.
age.notes: Database-derived occurrence snapshot from Paleobiology Database reference 87482; not yet re-verified against the publication full text.

claims.summary: PBDB occurrence 1645837 records Rhabdodontidae in collection 163322, linked by PBDB to reference 87482.
PBDB stores the original/identified name as Rhabdodontidae indet. and the accepted name as Rhabdodontidae.
